name: billing-entitlement
description: Shared test input for the entitlement contract in docs/BILLING-ENTITLEMENT.md. Every case is a stored account (the users projection) plus instants to ask at and the exact /me answer and relay admission expected. The site, the relay, the desktop app and the iPhone app each load this file and run their own implementation against it. All ids and logins are synthetic.

rules.instants: UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds and a Z suffix, in the file and on the wire
rules.deadlineExclusive: Access holds while now < deadline; at the deadline instant it is already over
rules.accessUntil: latest deadline among the grounds that hold now; null with relayAllowed true means no known end; null with relayAllowed false means no access
rules.relay: admit, or plan_required (HTTP 402 at connect, error frame then close 1008 mid-session); unauthorized (401) is a different answer

renewalSettlementSeconds.status: proposed by this contract, not one of the seven open decisions; 0 is the strict reading; to be confirmed against a sandbox test clock before enforcement

relayLookupCacheSeconds.status: recommended in the plan, never beyond accessUntil

currentSalePrice.note: Prices are Stripe Price ids read at runtime. These ids are placeholders; no amount appears anywhere in this file.
